==About==

A {{i|Grub De La Grub}} must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. Grub De La Grub is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Slugs Bugs and Kritters}} Food Group.
